info.title: site-assistant
info.description: Stages 1-8. Regional plans, usage and PostgreSQL quotas; see docs/billing.md. Universal integrations; see docs/finkoper-integration.md. Versioned lead collection and explicit confirmation; see docs/leads.md. Cabinet: cookie auth, exact PUBLIC_APP_URL Origin and X-CSRF-Protection: 1 on writes, JSON (multipart knowledge/upload and widget/logo). Public widget: separate exact-origin CORS, visitor bearer tokens, no cookies. Inbox: website only, assignment/role scoped, version/idempotency checks, DB-fenced AI handoff. Errors use stable error.code. See docs/operator-inbox.md and docs/widget.md.

metricsBearer.description: Separate deployment-only METRICS_TOKEN; private ingress only.

companyAPIKey.description: Company API key sa_...; scopes leads:read/leads:write; not a user cookie or JWT.

visitorBearer.description: Opaque anonymous session secret, not JWT. Bound to widget/session/origin; SHA-256 digest stored server-side.

domain.description: Bare DNS domain; IDN supported. No URL, port, IP, wildcard or path.

content.description: Extracted plain text, omitted as empty string in list responses

score.description: RRF score for hybrid, cosine similarity for semantic. Not a probability.

request_id.description: UUID for visitor/staff request; empty on an AI response in preview.
Client UUID idempotency key. Same key/body replays result; changed body conflicts.

manual.description: Website-only manual acceptance; no AI execution/assistant message.

privacy_url.description: Empty or HTTPS company privacy policy URL

available.description: Chat availability: manual messages remain possible when AI provider is disabled. Provider field describes AI mode.

token.description: Secret returned once. Keep in parent sessionStorage, never URL/logs.

execution_id.description: AI execution UUID or empty for manual messages

request_id.description: UUID for visitor/staff request; empty on an AI response in preview.

assignee.description: Member UUID, or empty to unassign (admin/owner only)

url.description: One-time secret fragment link, returned only on creation

token.description: Shown once. Store server-side; only SHA-256 digest persists.

url.description: Public HTTPS, no query/auth/redirects. Exact configured loopback exception in development only.

secret.description: Shown once, stored encrypted using WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
